newsitem.title: USA: DeVry school stake raised by N.Y. investor.
newsitem.headline: DeVry school stake raised by N.Y. investor.

text.p: New York investor Ronald Baron said Wednesday he raised his stake in DeVry Inc to 2,547,000 common shares or 7.7 percent from 6.4 percent held in December.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Baron said his latest transactions include the purchase of 355,500 between Feb 28 and March 26 at $19.2654 to $23.125 a share.
DeVry, based in Oakbrook Terrace, Ill., is a degree-granting school. Baron holds the stake for investment.
